propositions: A contributor must be able to manually re-trigger LLM-Review on a change with a coverage-gap -1 veto (any sub-reason except real finding) by posting a `recheck-review` comment, resetting the per-revision retry budget and enqueueing a forced re-review.

A `recheck-review` comment on a change whose current revision carries an LLM-Review BLOCK tagged as a real finding (both bare `[LLM-Review: BLOCK — finding]` and merge form with `(merge-change, N integrated commit(s))`) must be refused: no enqueue, no budget reset, no vote change, with a refusal reply posted and `RETRIGGER_REFUSED` logged.

The retrigger eligibility must be decided from durable Gerrit state (the bot's current-revision change message tag, parsed to strip merge-change suffix and classify all production tag shapes), never from contributor-controlled input, and unparseable or absent tags must be treated as eligible (fail-open to a fresh fail-closed review).
Comments authored by the bot itself and comments not containing the `recheck-review` word token must be silent no-ops with no reply or enqueue.
The refusal and queued-reply messages must be posted via REST with message body only, never writing any label (no `labels` key in the request body, preventing vote displacement).
The `/rerun` operator endpoint must reset the per-revision attempts budget before enqueueing a forced re-review, harmonizing with 0347's shared retry-bound semantics.
